question: If the front tyre is punctured,

options.text: The car will pull away from the side of the punctured tyre.
The car will pull to the side of the punctured tyre.
The car will move from side to side.

question: When negotiating a sharp bend, centrifugal force pushes your vehicle

options.text: Inwards.
Outwards.
Forward.

question: Reaction distance is the distance travelled from the moment, the

options.text: Brake is applied to the time the vehicle comes to a stop.
Hazard is seen to the time the vehicle comes to a stop.
Hazard is seen to the time the brake is applied.

question: Why is free wheeling wrong?

options.text: It will cause the vehicle to skid.
There is no engine braking.
The engine will run faster.

question: All drivers are required by law to switch on the vehicle's headlights whilst driving between

options.text: 7.00 pm and 7.00 am.
7.15 pm and 7.15 am.
7.30 pm and 7.30 am.

question: Switching on the headlights whilst driving in heavy rain during the daytime

options.text: Is advisable because you can be readily seen by others.
Is not advisable because it will shorten the battery life.
Is not advisable because the rain water will reflect the light.

question: As you appoach a controlled junction the lights change to green. Elderly people are halfway across, you should

options.text: Rev your engine to make them hurry.
Wait because they will take longer to cross.
Flash your lights to hurry them.

notes: Source typo in question: "appoach" (should be "approach"), kept as printed.

question: When approaching a green traffic light signal at a junction, you must

options.text: Speed up to drive through the junction.
Slow down and be prepared to stop.
Maintain your speed.

question: In this situation, the 'red' car should pay special attention to
picture: Video frame of a junction: red car near the corner, two schoolchildren on the kerb (A), a white car in the junction (B), a traffic light (C)

options.text: The school children.
The turning vehicle.
The traffic light.

notes: Picture panel is a video frame with a Repeat Video button.

question: When following behind a large vehicle, you should

options.text: Move more to the right to have a better view.
Keep a longer following distance as you would with other vehicles.
Follow at the same distance as you would with other vehicles.

notes: Option B wording as printed ("as you would"; likely meant "than you would").

question: The right most outer lane on a three-lane carriageway is for

options.text: Emergency vehicles and overtaking only.
Vehicles travelling at the maximum speed limit of the road.
Vehicles which are capable of travelling at high speed.

question: Generally, overheating of the engine is largely due to

options.text: Long distance driving.
Poor vehicle maintenance.
Lack of petrol.

question: The engine oil level on the dip stick should be

options.text: Below the lower marking.
Above the upper marking.
Between the lower and upper markings.

question: When your vehicle starts to skid while braking, you should

options.text: Step harder on the brake pedal.
Release the brakes and apply intermittent braking.
Neutralise the gear and apply the front brakes.

question: While driving along an expressway and your handphone (without hands-free kit) rings, you should

options.text: Answer the call immediately.
Carry on driving and find a safe spot out of the expressway before answering the call.
Stop at the road shoulder and answer the call.

notes: "hands-free" is hyphenated across a line break in the source.

question: Is it an offence to drive on the road shoulder of the expressway?

options.text: Yes, it is an offence.
It is not an offence.
It is not an offence if the road is congested.

question: When passing a cyclist, what is the minimum side clearance you must ensure between the cyclist and your car?

options.text: 1m

question: When a cyclist in front of you is glancing to the rear, it means that
picture: Top-down video frame: a red car on a straight two-lane road with a cyclist just ahead

options.text: He might change direction.
He is going to stop.
He is about to speed up.

notes: Picture panel is a video frame with a Repeat Video button.

question: A turn signal that keeps flashing after a turn is very likely to

options.text: Confuse other drivers and cause them to turn into your path.
Damage the electrical system.
Keep other drivers from seeing your brake light.

question: The rear view mirror inside the cabin should be adjusted so that

options.text: Only the right hand side of the rear windscreen can be seen in the mirror.
Only the left hand side of the rear windscreen can be seen in the mirror.
A full view of the rear windscreen can be seen in the mirror.
